value_text:
construct=purified putative encapsulating protein; variant_status=wild_type; curated_notes=Experimentally observed putative WT encapsulin assembly from B. laterosporus Bl 1821L. Babar et al. 2023 identified the 
~30 kDa purified preparation as consistent with A0A502IA18/WP_113757162 and observed predominantly globular or hexagonal capsid-like particles by TEM; related preparations had already shown encapsulin-like particles in Babar et al. 2022. Sequence analysis supports classification as a family 1 encapsulin shell protein. No quantitative particle diameter, T-number, shell subunit count or high-resolution shell structure was determined, so these fields are left blank. N-terminal analysis indicated possible co-migration with an adjacent ~25 kDa hypothetical protein.
source_id: Babar et al. 2022; Babar et al. 2023
condition:
native putative encapsulin purified from mitomycin 
C-induced Brevibacillus laterosporus Bl 1821L culture; sucrose-gradient/MWCO-enriched ~30 kDa preparation; capsid-like particles observed by TEM
